deals.title: Amazon Prime for Young Adults
deals.eligibility: Anyone aged 18 to 24, or a student, in the United States.
deals.howToGet: Start the six-month free trial on Amazon's Prime for Young Adults page and confirm your age or enrolment. After the trial it renews at $7.49 a month, or $69 a year. Cancel any time.
deals.sourceQuote: Enjoy a 6-month trial of Prime for Young Adults. Then get Prime at half the price, just $14.99 $7.49 per month. Cancel anytime.

deals.title: Amtrak student discount, 15% off
deals.eligibility: Students aged 17 to 24 with a valid student ID.
deals.howToGet: Book on Amtrak.com at least one day ahead; the discount applies automatically to qualifying travel, or enter code V814 in the Amtrak app. Coach and Acela Business Class only; some routes are excluded.
deals.sourceQuote: Amtrak is offering students between ages 17-24 the chance to save 15% on purchases made one (1) day in advance with our national student discount
